overview: Master Kettleby called from Somerset House, among the hampers. The court removes to Richmond today, and my lord with it. Sir Thomas's place is not filled. His lady must render the accounts before anyone signs, and the Chamber pays nobody till then. You will be sent for. Pay is another office's question. My lord has heard of the king from four persons and disliked none of the reports. He told you to mend your hose.
